about_mission:
Free. Local. Private. For Everyone.

No subscriptions. No cloud. No paywalls.
No more being left behind because you don't speak computer.

Plug in. Play. Save.
about_miranda_body:
She was a friend. A light. A reason.

She never got to see what AI would become.
She is the reason this is free, and the reason it always will be.

She will never be forgotten.
about_note_body:
I built this because I watched AI become the most powerful
tool in human history — and then watched companies build walls
around it so only people with money or technical skills could use it.

I don't think that's okay.

I'm not a computer guy. I'm a single father who learned just enough
to do this. If I can figure it out, I can make it so you don't have to.

This is free. It will always be free.
Use it kindly.
about_credit:
Built by Ryan Dennison for his son and the world.
Utilizing AI assistance.
